newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Buy-side bias to expiration seen.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Buy-side bias to expiration seen.

text.p: U.S. stock index options investors and traders continued to expect a positive bias to this week's expiration of December contracts, even as the market rallied sharply Thursday afternoon.
"Based upon the open interest, there could be a slight buy imbalance," said Michael Schwartz, a managing director at Oppenheimer & Co.
This week sees the expiration of December stock index futures, index options and individual equity options.
